title: Tunnel overlay registry contract (L2)
description: Sparse audited graph of cross-cell routing shortcuts. See ADR-038.

invariants.name: sparse_threshold
invariants.description: Default min_trust_score=0.70 to add a tunnel. Operator-tunable.
must: default 0.70
tunnels below threshold rejected at write time
threshold readable from this contract, not hardcoded in Python

invariants.name: auditable_provenance
invariants.description: Every tunnel has provenance_event_id pointing to the co-fire event that justified it. NULL forbidden.
must: provenance_event_id field is required and non-null on every tunnel
validator rejects tunnels missing or null provenance
operator-added hand-edit tunnels MUST cite a provenance_event_id (operator-edit event)

invariants.name: direction_enum
invariants.description: direction value is 'forward' or 'negative'. Negative tunnels (L5) extend the registry, not a separate registry.
must: direction in {forward, negative}
negative tunnels stored alongside forward, distinguished by enum
routing path interprets negative as 'do NOT route here'

invariants.name: yaml_persistence
invariants.description: Registry persisted as YAML at configs/tunnel_overlay.yaml.
must: yaml_path = configs/tunnel_overlay.yaml exactly
loaded via yaml.CSafeLoader for fast parse
operator hand-edits supported (clean YAML round-trip)

invariants.name: hot_path_lookup_budget
invariants.description: tunnel_registry.lookup_tunnels() must be < 5 µs per call. Matches L34 hot-path budget.
must: lookup uses indexed dict (from_cell -> [tunnel_ids]) not linear scan
p50 lookup latency under 5 µs verified by hot-path contract test
if budget tightens, lookup index must be tightened (e.g., flat hash table)

invariants.name: slots_dataclass
invariants.description: Tunnel record uses @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) per L60-NEW pattern.
must: Tunnel decorator must be @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
immutable record semantics
memory-efficient instantiation

invariants.name: revalidation_freshness
invariants.description: Periodic revalidation; tunnels not revalidated > 90 days auto-archive (kept in YAML, active=false).
must: revalidation_interval_days default 30
archive_after_days_stale default 90
archived tunnels remain in YAML with active=false flag
router skips active=false tunnels in lookup

out_of_scope: L5 negative tunnel mining (direction enum here; mining elsewhere)
